about: The UFC market disagreement guard (model_loop/adapters/ufc/guard.py; the simulator's copy is simulator/src/sports/ufc/guard.ts). When the served model and the market's no-vig price for the same fighter differ by more than threshold_pp percentage points, the bout is labelled 'Model disagrees with market' with both numbers side by side and the factors that likely explain the gap, never as an edge. A gap is shown as a signal only when the study certifies that gaps of that size beat the closing line (certify).

certify.rule: On out-of-sample bouts (2021 on) where |model - close| > threshold_pp: n >= min_n, the model's log loss below the closing line's with the card-blocked 95% interval of the difference below zero, and the closing line timestamped. An untimestamped reference can refuse certification, never grant it.
